mapper.select: select id, username, password, nickname, avatar, role from user where username = #{username} and password = #{password}
mapper.update: update user set nickname = #{updateUserDTO.nickname}, avatar = #{updateUserDTO.avatar} where id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT DATE(create_time) AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM user WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} - 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY date
